在“地球与星空”调整画质和标注。地理标注显示国家、首都和地形，星图显示恒星与星座: Adjust quality and annotations under Earth & sky. Geography labels show countries, capitals and terrain; sky annotations show stars and constellations. The note in the lower left opens the music player.

画面流畅度取决于电脑性能。可先使用流畅或标准画质，再提高细节。点击音符播放音乐，: Rendering performance depends on your computer. Start with Smooth or Standard quality, then increase detail. Click the note to play music; open the playlist to import, remove and reorder tracks.
